dialogue.speech: That's just a normal mirror,the kind you can find anywhere.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: No matter what your Stand is doing out there...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: No matter what ability it may use...

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Not even viruses can enter Mirror Man's world!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio, Giorno, please get my message...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Please make sure you don't get dragged into the mirror!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: We need to hurry, Giorno!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Hey, Giorno!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Don't just stand there! Let's go!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Let me ask you this... Where are we going?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: To get the key?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: You're willing to abandon Fugo, who's in danger right now?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Watch your mouth, you b*stard.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Listen up. Our mission is to get the key and safely get that girl to the boss!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I want to save Fugo as much as you do,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: but getting that key is paramount right now!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Even if I was the one currently being attacked instead of Fugo,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I would want you guys to abandon me.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I beg your pardon...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but I don't believe that's true!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Fugo is indeed in danger, but he hasn't lost!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We should risk our lives and save him!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: And making any movements when we don't know the enemy's ability

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: is dangerous to us, as well.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: No! All three of us being taken out is the worst possible outcome!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I'll say it again! We're moving on! Come on!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: And I humbly decline!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We're going to solve this mystery, save Fugo, and defeat the enemy!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's the best way to ensure we're all safe!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I have seniority here, so in this situation, what I say goes!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Are you still going to decline?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: You'd better be prepared!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: That is, if you manage to survive!

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I'll ask you one more time, Fugo.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: What are you looking for here?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I have no intention of telling you.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I see.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: Very well. There are still two others.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: I just need the last one standing to tell me.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: You're finished. Take this!
